title: Scalar reward is not enough: A response to Silver, Singh, Precup and Sutton (2021)
reasoning: The paper is centered on a critique of the 'Reward is Enough' hypothesis from an ethical and moral perspective. It argues that scalar rewards are insufficient to represent the complexity of human moral pluralism and ethics. Section 6 and 6.2 specifically explore human ethics, value systems, and the moral imperatives for responsible AGI design, making it a core component of the paper's argument.
